ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

switch-group.description: Groups related boolean settings. Each child switch represents a named boolean option. Value is Record<string, boolean>.

examples.note: A set of independent toggles sharing one FormControl. Children inherit the group size and density unless they set their own.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the switch group components.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: The group owns size and density; every child follows unless it overrides one of them.

switch-group.title: Switch Group

validation.note: Bounds are validated live: at least one and at most two channels must be enabled.
